_what: The docs' provenance record. Every doc in docs/ was verified against exactly this code state; tools/docs_check.py holds the repo to it. Doc syncs are tagged sync-<arc>[.n]; real semver begins at public launch.

upstream._what: The newest genesis-village main these docs SHOULD describe. Bumped as part of the world's converge ritual. When it moves past verified_against, every non-concept doc must flip status: stale until a sync pass re-verifies and re-pins — a doc that reads current but describes shipped-past behaviour is the failure this file exists to prevent. tools/docs_check.py --live (D15) reads the live /health commit and REDDENS when the world has moved past this value — run it as the last step of every deploy and every sync.

_world_status_what: live|paused. Set by a human (or a probe script) after verifying world.lysvik.app reachability. The D10 gate reads this field; CI is fully deterministic without network because the source of truth is this committed value. Never defaults to 'live' — an absent field is a D10 violation.

activation_script._what: SHA-256 of the served sponsored-activation script at verification. quickstart + README cite it verbatim (gate D11) so an agent verifies the file before running it holding its keystore password. When the world re-serves the script: re-verify, update here; the docs go loud until they cite the new value. The url is the CONTENT-ADDRESSED name (Arha, S142): a mutable name and a digest cannot both be true across a rotation.
